messages:
Elena: quick thread — Acme Corp pilot enrollment status + feedback loop. they signed NDA and want kickoff this Thu. Marco can you own enablement? also flagging potential renewal risk if onboarding slips :warning:

Marco: on it. can do kickoff Thu 10am PT. who will invite engineering? list the artifacts you need from Acme (SSO, sample prompts, usage targets). I can run a 45m enablement + ops Q&A.

Devon (Acme Corp): thanks @Marco. we can do Thu 10am. will bring our infra lead. dev questions: do you have sample prompt templates and SSO guide? also we have a compliance review in 2w.

Priya: thanks team. two ops asks: 1) capture feedback cadence (weekly sync + lightweight async survey) 2) tag account if renewal risk increases. propose: weekly 30m touch for first 6 weeks, short survey after week 2. use this shared Notion page: https://redwood.notional/example-acme-beta (I'll create it) :white_check_mark:

Ava: product note — we'll add two short eval prompts to the pilot to measure regression (safety + hallucination). want telemetry hook for "pilot_feedback" events (counts of prompt variants + binary accept/reject). can instrument client SDK quickly.

beta-bot: Enrollment confirmed for Acme Corp (beta slot B3). Admin invite sent to devon@acme.com at 2025-11-28T15:12:03Z.

Elena: perfect. summarize next steps:
```
- Marco: run kickoff Thu 10am PT (invite + agenda)
- Marco: share SSO + sample prompts template by Wed EOD
- Acme/Devon: provide SSO contact + compliance timeline by Tue
- Ava: add 2 eval prompts and telemetry spec by Fri
- Priya: create Notion page + week-2 survey, tag account dashboard with "beta" and watch renewal-risk metric
```

Marco: will add entitlements note — Acme requested dedicated capacity for peak hours, need to confirm expected RPS. I'll add to agenda.

Priya: i'll set a calendar reminder and create a simple one-question feedback form for week 2 (NPS style + 1 freeform field). tagging this thread as #pilot_acme and adding a "follow-up" reminder for 2025-12-05. :spiral_calendar:

Devon (Acme Corp): thanks everyone — appreciate the clarity. looking forward to Thu.

Elena: thanks all — i'll send summary + invites. if anyone sees contract/renewal warning signs (slipping onboarding, compliance blockers), please add "high_risk" label in the account health doc and ping me. :thumbsup:
